title: Pisces Beware The Cosmic Shift Today
script_text: Stop! Pisces, stars are screaming at you right now. Mercury forms a precise trine to Neptune, your ruler, lighting your 4th House of home, while Venus sextiles Jupiter in your 10th House, boosting career confidence. A Saturn square to your Ascendant hints at lingering doubts, but a Neptune‑Mercury trine to the 7th House gifts romantic intuition. Additionally, a Scorpio Moon in your 12th House amplifies intuition, urging you to listen to inner guidance. Single Pisces may attract a mysterious artist, while couples should guard against idealizing. The Venus‑Jupiter sextile fuels the 10th House with a breakthrough or bonus, yet Saturn urges you to curb spending. This momentum could bring a small inheritance or unexpected raise, but stay diligent in budgeting. Beware impulsive water‑element urges; meditate instead for sudden financial clarity. Follow for tomorrow's reading and stay tuned for week's cosmic shifts.
